passage.label: No Indeed record righteous illiyyun; what make know illiyyun; register inscribed; witnessed those brought near; Indeed righteous pleasure; adorned couches observing; recognize faces radiance pleasure; given drink pure wine sealed; last musk for this let competitors compete; mixture Tasneem; spring those near drink

arabicExcerpts.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ

mainSubject.label: The record of the righteous placed in Illiyyun, an inscribed register witnessed by those brought near; the righteous in pleasure on adorned couches observing, their faces bearing recognisable radiance; served sealed pure wine whose finish is musk — for which competitors should compete — mixed from Tasneem, a spring from which those brought near drink

Radiance of pleasure recognisable in their faces

A spring from which those brought near drink

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the standing-before-the-Lord statement (6) before the Sijjeen record block opens (7); P2 ends with the this-is-what-you-denied declaration (17) before the Illiyyun record block begins (18); P3 runs through the inscribed register, couch-radiance, sealed wine and Tasneem spring (18-28); P4 covers the criminal-mockery catalogue and its eschatological reversal (29-36).
